slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: sections
slots.about: the rows in order: id, name, form ("chips": kinds to pick; "cards": things)

slots.name: items
slots.about: everything in the rows: id, section (a section id), name, meta (a short second line on a card, may be blank), kind (on a card: the id of the chip it belongs to; 0 on a chip), added (true or false, cards only)

slots.name: open_after
slots.about: a card row with more items than this gets a chevron that opens it as a list

slots.name: add_word
slots.about: spoken before a card's name when not added

slots.name: remove_word
slots.about: spoken before a card's name when added

slots.name: open_word
slots.about: spoken before a row's name on its chevron while closed

slots.name: close_word
slots.about: spoken before a row's name on its chevron while open

slots.name: empty_text
slots.about: what shows when no row has anything

empty.shows: empty; a row with nothing (or nothing of the picked kind) hides

fallback.shows: a short card row has no chevron

attention.shows: the picked chip fills and every card row keeps only that kind; chip rows stay whole

labels.chevron: open_word or close_word and the row name
labels.card: add_word or remove_word and the name
labels.line: add_word or remove_word and the name

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise, shrink and swap

notes: Cards hug their content: the size roles hold no card width, so a fixed poster or 16:9 tile needs a core size role first. The chip rows run off the edge the same way the reference does.
